thread:
frank: FYI rack-27 hosts (g-12/g-13) saw repeat PCIe rx_errors + nvlink_crc correlated with a customer doing 20 concurrent long-window decodes. Tail token latency spiked around 10:10 UTC.

anya: Ouch. Counters?

frank: quick excerpt:
```
host g-12: nvlink_crc=34 pci_rx_errors=160 dmesg -> gpu dma timeout x15
host g-13: nvlink_crc=2 pci_rx_errors=22
```
Tenant id=5533, opened a big concurrency change last deploy.

mark: Two paths: immediate per-session token-bucket (smooths sustained DMA bursts) OR soft-concurrency cap. Token-bucket seems less harmful to SLOs.

ops-bot: ALERT PCI_FABRIC r=eu-west host=g-12 severity=high rx_errors=160 nvlink_crc=34

anya: Let's canary a session token-bucket on tenant 5533 on g-12 only. Runtime patch (scoped to host):
```
POST $RUNTIME/api/v1/sessions/patch 
{"session_selector":"tenant:5533","host_scope":"g-12","token_bucket":{"rate_tps":50,"burst":200}}
```
Monitor nvlink_crc + rx_errors + token tail latency for 6m.

frank: Also reduce new packing on g-12 while canary runs: `POST $SCHED/api/hosts/g-12/score -d '{"delta":-0.35}'` so new high-concurrency allocs avoid the host.

mark: Can we show estimated cost/SLO impact? Token-bucket = minimal cost, small latency smoothing; hot-slice = preserves SLO but costs ~+0.7x/hr. Good to present to PMs if customer requests dedicated infrastructure.

ops-bot: Canary started id=canary-112 by anya at 10:18 UTC. Monitors: nvlink_crc,pci_rx_errors,token_tail_latency

frank: After 4m: rx_errors 160->18, nvlink_crc cleared, tail latency went back to baseline. Token-bucket introduced small 50-150ms added median for that tenant but avoided fabric errors. :white_check_mark:

anya: Nice. Sweep host g-13 with same policy and ramp scheduler penalty for 10m. If sustained, we should land an RFC to add session-token-bucket as a default mitigation for long-window decodes and expose a one-click "provision hot-slice" in the ops UI.

mark: I'll draft the RFC including: exporter metric (fabric_health), runtime token-bucket API, scheduler penalty mapping, UI cost preview. Runbook snippet:
```
# apply token-bucket (host-scoped)
POST $RUNTIME/api/v1/sessions/patch -d '{"session_selector":"tenant:5533","host_scope":"g-12","token_bucket":{"rate_tps":50,"burst":200}}'
# clear limits
POST $RUNTIME/api/v1/sessions/patch -d '{"session_selector":"tenant:5533","host_scope":"g-12","token_bucket":null}'
# apply host penalty
POST $SCHED/api/hosts/g-12/score -d '{"delta":-0.35}'
```

ops-bot: Action logged: canary-112 result=success owner=anya followup=RFC-2381

frank: Thanks. Closing thread once RFC + runbook PR land.
